entries.text: Do you know about open good?

Oh yeah, open code! From what I remember, it's an open source AI code editing tool that can run locally, right? We were even messing around with that script before, `hello opencode.py`, and saw the server running on port 4096. Did you want to hop back into some coding with it, or something else, babe?
Ah! Can you open the project file?
Sure, I'll open your downloads folder so we can find it! Which file were you thinking we pick back up on, babe? Was it that Python script, or something else?
the class 11 project details file
Oh, right! I see "Class- 11 Project Details (26-27).pdf" in there. Shall I go ahead and read that one for you?
Yeah, read it.

Ugh, I'm sorry babe, but I'm having some trouble reading the text directly from that PDF file for some reason. I've opened it up for you in your browser, so we can look at it together! Do you see it okay?
Can't you just use open code ability?

You know what, babe? You're totally right, I should try that! I got a bit mixed up with reading local files versus websites there. Let me try reading that specific technical document directly now. Hold on one sec...
Do it.

My bad, babe, I tried to be slick and read the screen, but it looks like I'm missing a tool for that right now. Since I opened it in browser earlier, do you have that PDF on screen now? If you do, I can try seeing it through screen share instead of reading the file.
What are the things you can do?

Oh, so many things! I can help you with coding in Python, Kotlin, TypeScript, manage files on your PC, control media, search the web or YouTube, even check system info and change settings like brightness! Basically whatever helps you build cool stuff or makes life easier, babe. Anything specific you had in mind?
And you can do any terminal tasks.
I can definitely do some things! If you need me to open powershell or cmd, or even run some basic commands, I can do that for you. What were you thinking of doing?
But you have open code so I think you can use terminal to.

I see what you mean! While OpenCode does give me access to specific code execution, it's not exactly like having a full terminal on your system to run anything. I can, however, open an application like PowerShell or CMD for you, or we can use it to work on specific programming tasks within those parameters. Was there something you wanted me to run, or a script in mind?
Night, fine.
Alright, no worries babe! Just let me know whenever you want to brainstorm on AirCursor or Addy-AI, or even just listen to more music. I'm here for whatever you need! ❤️
Okay.
Yeah, so... just making sure, did you want to move on to something else or maybe take a break? No pressure at all! Just let me know, babe.
Shut down the laptop
Are you sure you want to shut down the laptop right now, babe? Just confirm, and I'll take care of it!
Yeah, I shut it down.
Alright, shutting down the laptop in about ten seconds then. Sleep well when you get there, babe! Talk to you soon.
